description: Ask ellul.ai for a written fixed quote on a person's behalf. Use ONLY when the person has asked you to request the quote and has given you their own name and email. This sends ONE email to that person asking them to confirm; nothing reaches ellul.ai and nothing is requested until they press the link in it, so always tell them to check their inbox. One request to an address a day. If they would rather ask themselves, use how_to_get_a_quote.

email.description: The person's own email address; the confirmation is sent here

note.description: What they need, in their words (up to 1,000 characters)

person_asked.description: Must be true: the person asked you to send this request and gave you these details

phone.description: Their phone number, if they gave one

name: request_quote
title: Send a quote request for the person to confirm
